global_issues.title: 30y Treasury Yield Reclaims 5% as Buyback Rally Fizzles
global_issues.note: Confirmed by multiple sources. 30y yield hit a 19-year high near 5.33% on 2026-08-18, eased somewhat on Treasury's expanded buyback operations (Bessent doubled buyback size to $4B on 2026-08-21), but remained above 5% (~5.25% as of 2026-08-21). Narrative of yields staying elevated despite buyback support is well corroborated.

global_issues.title: Oil Extends Rally on Hormuz and Iran Risks Despite Crude Build
global_issues.note: Confirmed. Brent near $90/bbl and WTI elevated amid stalled US-Iran negotiations over Strait of Hormuz reopening; talks that produced a June MOU collapsed over shipping-route disputes, keeping risk premium in oil. Consistent with briefing's framing.

grok_report.summary: The two global issues (30y yield above 5%, oil rally on Iran/Hormuz risk) and the market mood (SPY +0.41%, risk-on) are well-supported by current reporting. The briefing omits the same-day Treasury buyback expansion announcement and PLTR insider-selling context, and one watchlist price (TSLA) couldn't be cleanly reconciled against independently found intraday data, though the briefing's percentage math is self-consistent.
